description:
Found by the fz-kdt.210 research and CONFIRMED independently by its cold
review (2026-09-03). Reproduces identically at base dd07432db and under
fz-kdt.210`s prototype, so 210 does not fix it -- it is the natural successor.

fz-kdt.210 fixes the RETURN side of a partial join: a @spec variable whose
covariant occurrences include one the walk cannot read (an opaque reducer
arrow arriving as a bare address var, so collect_arrow_match finds no
callable_clauses and answers Unknown) was treated as fully joined, so the
result was called Known -- a runtime fact -- from a join that never finished.

THIS TICKET IS THE PARAMETER HALF OF THE SAME ROOT. refine_contract_inputs
instantiates the reducer`s ARROW from that same partial join and clamps it to
the SEED accumulator, so the ascent stops one rung short and a legitimate
program is rejected with a false error[spec/violation].

REPRODUCER: probe/seed.fz in the fz-kdt.210 research artifacts -- a fold whose
accumulator seed is an ATOM. Swapping the seed to `[]` makes it compile,
because the fz-f98.16 empty-list cleaner masks the list case; that masking is
why this has been invisible, and fz-kdt.120 deletes that cleaner.

WHY IT IS ITS OWN TICKET: 210 is confined to the calculator
(types/arrow_match.rs marks a partially joined variable so the RESULT answers
Underconstrained). The clamp lives at a different seam -- contract.rs
refine_contract_inputs, consuming an instantiation as a refinement of the
INPUT surface. 210 deliberately leaves the parameter surface alone
(Underconstrained still publishes `params`), which its review confirms is a
conscious choice, so the parameter half needs its own rule.

CONCORDANT, and an owner must decide whether to FOLD: fz-kdt.181 (P1, open --
"Types::intersect deletes a union member whose surface member carries a free
type variable, and refine_contract_inputs consumes the erasure as a
refinement") is the same FUNCTION and the same class of harm, with the erasure
arriving from intersect rather than from a partial instantiation; this
reproducer is already recorded as a comment there. fz-kdt.132 (closed) is the
same CLAMP shape arriving from a closure clause rather than from a @spec.

RED-FIRST: probe/seed.fz compiles and prints on all three doors, with the
empty-list cleaner both intact and deleted.
title: The PARAMETER half of a partial join is a false spec/violation: refine_contract_inputs clamps a reducer's arrow to the seed accumulator, so the ascent stops one rung short
